conversation.message:
Hello, I’m CIRA, the Clinical Intake and Risk Assessment assistant at St. Michael’s Hospital, Unity Health Toronto. I’ll collect some information before your appointment, one question at a time.

What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Uh, I usually just go by James — do you need the full thing?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, please provide your complete legal name as it appears on your legal documents.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: James Campbell

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: How would you like your gender recorded?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think just male — is that what you mean?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please provide your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full legal home address, including the street address, city, and province?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: 9 Prince Arthur Avenue, Toronto, Ontario

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your Canadian postal code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: M5R1B2

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your email address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: james.campbell@example.com

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your phone number?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a family doctor?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, I do. I have a family doctor.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your family doctor’s full name, including their first and last name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Dr. Eva Lindqvist

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a psychiatrist?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t have one.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately? Please describe what happens, where it occurs, and any specific consequences or events.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s mostly at work, I think — I’ve been kind of floundering on a simple project and just can’t seem to get moving. Do you want the work part, or the more general part?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Both would be helpful. At work, what specifically happens when you try to work on the project—for example, difficulty concentrating, low motivation, feeling overwhelmed, or something else?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, concentration is a big part of it, and I’m just kind of flat and slowed down. It’s worse in the mornings. Also I can’t really picture where things are headed, if that makes sense.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment? Please include anything else you would like help with.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I want to get back to functioning at work and be able to move forward again.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental health professional?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t think so, no — not that I remember.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received a psychiatric diagnosis, such as depression, anxiety, OCD, or bipolar disorder?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, depression before — back in college, and it’s been recurrent.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further psychiatric diagnoses you’re aware of?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, that’s the only one I know of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health reasons?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, never.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever thought about or tried to intentionally hurt yourself?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received CBT, DBT, Interpersonal Therapy, Mindfulness-Based Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, or another type of therapy?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Not really one of those, no. I did take some time off after my father died, if that counts?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: I’m sorry for your loss. Taking time off after your father died does not sound like therapy unless you met with a therapist or counsellor. Did you receive any counselling or therapy during that time?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t think I saw a therapist or counsellor then.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received rTMS, ECT, deep brain stimulation, ketamine treatment, or another biological treatment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, none of those.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are you currently taking any prescribed medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, I’m on something for my mood. I take one tablet each morning.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is the name of the medication, if you know it?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t remember the name, sorry.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is the medication for—for example, depression, anxiety, or another condition?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Uh, it’s for my mood, I think — that’s the main thing. Maybe you mean what it’s supposed to help with specifically?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, that’s what I mean. What symptoms or condition is it intended to help with—for example, depression, anxiety, or mood changes?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: For depression, I believe.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What dose do you take? For example, is it 5 mg, 10 mg, or 20 mg?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t know the dose, unfortunately.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are you taking any other prescribed medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, just that one.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you previously tried any psychiatric medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t taken any others that I can remember.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, none that I know of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever had any surgical procedures?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, no surgeries.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your height? Please provide it in centimetres or feet and inches.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m about 183 cm, give or take.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your weight? Please provide it in kilograms or pounds.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Around 79 kg.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you have any known allergies to medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t have any medication allergies that I know of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have any of your family members been diagnosed with a mental health condition, such as depression, anxiety, OCD, bipolar disorder, or schizophrenia?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes — my mother has depression.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What additional details, if any, would you like to share about your mother’s depression?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t really know more than that.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further family members with a mental health condition?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, my sister has depression too.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What additional details, if any, would you like to share about your sister’s depression?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Uh, not really much more that I know offhand. It’s kind of the same story there, I think.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further family members with a mental health condition?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes — my maternal uncle died by suicide.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What additional details, if any, would you like to share about your maternal uncle?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t know much beyond that, just that he died by suicide.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further family members with a mental health condition?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.message: Apart from alcohol used as part of cooking or religious ceremonies, have you ever used alcohol—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.message: Apart from prescribed nicotine replacement or other medical treatment, have you ever used cigarettes, vaping products, or other nicotine—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, I mean use outside prescribed medical treatment, including taking someone else’s prescription or taking more than prescribed. Apart from medication prescribed to you and taken as directed, have you ever used benzodiazepines such as Valium, Ativan, or Xanax—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Are you currently involved in any active legal cases?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t think so — not that I’m aware of. Do you mean anything ongoing right now?

conversation.message: What is the highest level of education you have completed?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I have a master’s degree, in architecture.

conversation.message: Could you tell me about your recent employment history? For each job, please include the employer, job title, and start and end dates or approximate duration.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes, please. What are your start and end dates at Northline Studio, or approximately how long have you worked there?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I started there in 2020 and I’m still there.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further recent jobs you would like to add?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you describe your early childhood, including where you were born, where you grew up, and what you were like as a young child?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I was born and grew up… I mean, just grew up normally, nothing special I can really add.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. Where were you born, and how would you describe yourself as a young child—for example, shy, outgoing, sensitive, or energetic?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t really know where I was born exactly, and I can’t say I remember much about being a little kid.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you describe your adolescence and early adulthood, including your experience in school, any difficulties, jobs or responsibilities, and other important experiences?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah — college was a big part of that time, and my father died from leukemia. That’s probably the main thing I remember from then.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you describe the significant relationships in your life, including family, friendships, and any romantic partnerships? You may mention approximate dates or duration and whether they are current or ended.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: My spouse and I have separated after about 6 years of marriage, and the divorce is in progress. I’m also interested in a coworker, if that matters.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any other significant relationships you would like to mention, including family or friendships?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t think so.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What goals do you have for the future, such as related to your health, education, employment, relationships, family, or personal development?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I want to rebuild things and get my career moving again.
